text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact was injured during practice, 
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I apologize 
for causing you such worry.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
However, as you can see, it's merely a 
light scratch. 
Shall we resume our training?
choice_data_list: No, let's play it safe and rest.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you for your concern. 
Truly, though, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, I'd end up with scrapes 
and cuts 
in the mountains almost every day, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Pain like this is nothing to me.
choice_data_list: If it hurts, you shouldn't push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Truly, it's nothing that some crushed 
plantain leaves 
pressed onto it wouldn't soothe in no 
time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I don't think it will affect my running 
much, 
so won't you please let me 
continue training?
choice_data_list:
Even the slightest setback can prove fatal 
out there.

All right, let's take it easy and see how 
it goes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even a slight rise in a river's water 
level 
creates a current strong enough to sweep a 
person away—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Racing is just the same. A harsh world 
where the slightest 
margins can dictate victory or defeat...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I mustn't take it lightly. 
Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
For today, just as you say, 
I will focus entirely on recovering.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer. 
Could we actually call it a day after all?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Fortunately, nothing has happened 
just yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I had a sudden premonition— 
that pushing any further would end badly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though it wasn't serious yet, I trusted 
Daring Tact's 
intuition and had her rest until she made 
a full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hah, whew...
choice_data_list:
Thank goodness, seems like everything's 
okay.

Thank goodness, seems like everything's 
okay.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! But I mustn't make you worry 
any more than necessary, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Could we stick to a lighter regimen 
for the rest of today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact stuck to a light training 
schedule for a while, 
allowing her to make a smooth and steady 
recovery.
